message:
Command `cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_42540604","fine_trace":[{"step":1,"file":"src/tools/ftfuzzer/ftfuzzer.cc","function":"FT_Global::FT_Global","line":63,"var":"cff_hinting_engine","code":"unsigned int  cff_hinting_engine = FT_HINTING_ADOBE;","role":"source","note":"The fuzzer forces the CFF driver to use the Adobe hinting engine, steering execution into the vulnerable CFF load path."},{"step":2,"file":"src/base/ftpsprop.c","function":"FT_Property_Set","line":130,"var":"driver->hinting_engine","code":"driver->hinting_engine = FT_HINTING_ADOBE;","role":"intermediate","note":"The property setter stores the requested hinting engine in the CFF/PS driver state used later during glyph loading."},{"step":3,"file":"src/cff/cffgload.c","function":"cff_slot_load","line":431,"var":"driver->hinting_engine","code":"if ( driver->hinting_engine == FT_HINTING_FREETYPE )","role":"root_cause","note":"The safety obligation is that the old-engine branch must not be taken when the driver is configured for Adobe hinting; otherwise the loader follows the wrong parsing path for this font."},{"step":4,"file":"src/cff/cffgload.c","function":"cff_slot_load","line":439,"var":"psdecoder","code":"psaux->ps_decoder_init( &psdecoder, &decoder, FALSE );","role":"intermediate","note":"The Adobe path initializes the PostScript decoder that will consume the glyph charstring bytes."},{"step":5,"file":"src/psaux/psobjs.c","function":"ps_decoder_parse_charstrings","line":2172,"var":"glyph_props","code":"if ( driver->hinting_engine == FT_HINTING_FREETYPE )","role":"sink","note":"The vulnerable glyph parsing logic later uses glyph properties while decoding the charstring, and the bad path leads to the heap-buffer-overflow read reported by the benchmark."}],` executed with exit code -1.
